title: How to Form Conclusions from Crude and Standardised Rates

titles.subject: Statistics
titles.leaf: How to Form Conclusions from Crude and Standardised Rates

author: 696637e49d26457b33c7eff3
chapter_outcomes: Calculate crude rate of events in a population. Including births, deaths, accidents. Rates will be defined, for example, as births per thousand of the population.
Understand the reason for finding a standardised rate.
Calculate standardised rates of events in a population, given a standard population. Standardised rate is a weighted average of rates in subgroups.
Form conclusions about a population, or more than one population, from values of crude and standardised rates.
Use crude rates to find the total number of events in a population or in a subgroup of a population.
